docker_integration.scope: Disposable TLS PG18/OpenBao, 17 invented records, actual A+B schema/toolkit, live HTTPS backend; not production or official benchmark datasets

operational_steps: Apply reviewed TLS updater once to existing pg-dpr
Run idempotent B schema setup on the active protected database to grant backup_user SELECT on service allocator
Make a new seven-table service backup; restore and cut over according to app/docs/RECOVERY.md
limitations: Integrated recovery passed on 17 invented rows in disposable containers; target-team migrated dataset acceptance and official benchmark are separate
Existing pg-dpr was not modified; deployment still requires the TLS apply and idempotent B setup described in the runbook
Browser frontend tests are separate; this recovery proof exercises the live HTTPS backend
Earlier WSL startup failure is retained as historical evidence and is superseded by this successful run
reproduction_command: Set DPR_BACKUP_INTEGRATION=1 and DPR_POSTGRES_TLS_INTEGRATION=1; python -m pytest --import-mode=importlib infra/tests/test_postgres_tls_integration.py scripts/backup/tests/test_integration.py scripts/backup/tests/test_service_recovery_integration.py -q --tb=short
